# Hunker

> > Hunker is a comprehensive home improvement and lifestyle resource offering expert-backed DIY tutorials, gardening advice, interior design inspiration, and practical how-to guides for homeowners.

The site features content from home improvement experts like Victoria Lee Blackstone, Chris Deziel, and Shelley Frost, covering everything from lawn care and companion planting to plumbing repairs and kitchen design. Hunker serves as a trusted resource for practical home maintenance, sustainable living practices, and interior decorating solutions.

## Key Topics

- Home Improvement
- DIY Projects
- Gardening Tips
- Interior Design
- Lawn Care
- Kitchen Appliances
- Plumbing Repairs
- Organization Hacks
- Sustainable Living
- Home Maintenance
- Companion Planting
- Shaker Style Design
- CPVC Plumbing
- Plant Toxicity
- Energy Efficiency

## Getting Started

- [Hunker: Inspired Home Design, Gardening Tips, and DIY Improvements](https://www.hunker.com): Homepage for home design, gardening, DIY, and improvement content

## Home Improvement & DIY Guides

- [How Deep To Dig Fence Post Holes](https://www.hunker.com/12000113/how-deep-to-dig-fence-post-holes): Tutorial on proper fence post hole depth and digging techniques
- [Plumber's Putty Vs. Teflon Tape](https://www.hunker.com/12000119/plumbers-putty-vs-teflon-tape): Comparison of PTFE Teflon tape vs plumber's putty for pipe sealing
- [How Long Must I Wait After Gluing CPVC Pipe Before Turning The Water Back On?](https://www.hunker.com/12000340/how-long-must-i-wait-after-gluing-cpvc-pipe-before-turning-the-water-back-on): CPVC solvent cement cure times and water pressure considerations
- [Texas Septic Tank Requirements](https://www.hunker.com/12000126/texas-septic-tank-requirements): Texas-specific septic tank permits, evaluations, and regulations guide
- [The Pros & Cons Of Beech Hardwood Flooring](https://www.hunker.com/12000358/the-pros-cons-of-beech-hardwood-flooring): Janka hardness scale review of beech hardwood flooring durability

## Gardening & Lawn Care

- [Can Grass Grow From Clippings?](https://www.hunker.com/12000083/can-grass-grow-from-clippings): Explains grass clippings decompose rather than grow new plants
- [What Plants Can Be Used As A Companion For A Lemon Tree?](https://www.hunker.com/12000350/what-plants-can-be-used-as-a-companion-for-a-lemon-tree): Companion planting guide for Citrus limon with beneficial insects
- [Are Jade Plants Poisonous To Dogs?](https://www.hunker.com/12000309/are-jade-plants-poisonous-to-dogs): Crassula ovata jade plant toxicity warning for dogs, cats, and horses
